docs: Belgrade installed. Add suppressHydrationWarning to the <html> tag in app/layout.tsx: the theme script sets the dark class before first paint. Belgrade's palette only applies on pages that render <SiteShell>, so the rest of your app keeps its theme. The contact form is a demo; wire it to a Server Action to send messages.
